title: The person finds a saved thing filed under the wrong subject
turns: I need to flag something odd. I was scrolling through my notes this morning and the steps for cleaning my bike chain are sitting at the bottom of the page about my sourdough trials.

I never asked for that to go there. I'd given you the chain steps weeks ago as their own thing, and now they're mixed in with flour and water ratios, which makes no sense. Why would you file it there?
